newsitem.title: USA: Clinton urged to name Wofford Labor Secretary.
newsitem.headline: Clinton urged to name Wofford Labor Secretary.

text.p: Republican Sen. Arlen Specter of Pennsylvania Friday endorsed his former Democratic colleague Harris Wofford to replace Robert Reich as labor secretary.

"I strongly recommend former Sen. Harris Wofford to be secretary of labor," Specter said in a letter to President Clinton. "His background in the Senate and his experience in Gov. (Robert) Casey's cabinet make him uniquely qualified for the position of secretary of labor."
Wofford was defeated for reelection to the Senate two years ago by Republican Rick Santorum.
